m: Rinse the rice and cook it: 1 cup rice to 1½ cups water, lid on, 12 minutes on low, then rest 10 minutes off the heat.
Sauce: mix the soy, oyster sauce, honey, sesame oil and 2 tablespoons of water in a cup.

Get a wok or big frying pan smoking hot with a splash of oil. Add the pork, press it flat and leave it 2 to 3 minutes until a crust forms underneath, then break it up and keep cooking until browned and crispy at the edges.
Push the pork to one side. Add the grated ginger and garlic, sliced chilli and the white parts of the spring onion and fry 30 seconds.
Add the broccolini (halved lengthways if thick) and snow peas with a splash of water and toss for 2 minutes until bright green but still crunchy.
Pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until it coats everything. Serve over the rice with the spring onion greens and chopped peanuts.
l: Pack the pork and greens over the rice. Microwave 2 minutes, stirring halfway. Keep the peanuts in a separate bag so they stay crunchy.
g: Tamari instead of soy. Most oyster sauce contains wheat, so find a gluten free one or use extra tamari with a pinch of sugar. Cook the GF portion first in a clean wok.
